Compute the resultant of P_16 and x²+x+1.

Res(P, x²+x+1) = product of P(ω) over the roots ω of x²+x+1 (times the leading coefficient factor). Specifically, Res(P, Q) = a_P^{deg Q} ∏ Q(α_i) = a_Q^{deg P} ∏ P(β_j).

Using the second formula: Res(P, x²+x+1) = lc(x²+x+1)^{deg P} ∏_{ω} P(ω) = 1^6 * P(ω) * P(ω²) (where ω is a primitive cube root of unity).

Since the coefficients of P are real, P(ω²) = conj(P(ω)), so the resultant = |P(ω)|².

Compute P(ω) with ω² = -1-ω, ω³ = 1.

ω^6 = 1
